Grain
The Scott Coop is a strong grain-based company that will take care of all your grain needs and questions. We are here to help producers maximize profitability and reduce the stress of marketing and delivering their grain. The merchandising staff will assist you in selling, forward contracting, and deferring payments. We have 8 locations in Scott and Wichita counties for grain delivery that will help get your harvest done in a timely manner. The Scott Coop has an app for grain that will let the you track every load of grain delivered to the elevators and see the bushels, moisture, and test weight on that load.
